notes:
- New look: a cleaner "Blueprint" design with icons, in light and dark. It follows your computer's setting, or choose under Appearance on the main window
- The tools toolbar starts along the top and can be moved to any side (drag its grip, or right-click a toolbar)
- Tool options are now in a Properties panel on the right; PDF pages in a Pages panel on the left. Both collapse to a slim strip
- The status bar shows the pointer position (in feet and inches once a scale is set) and the zoom
- The main window has capture tiles, a drop area for PDFs and a Recent files list
- Safer saving, redaction and page tools, from a security review
- Help has a new "Layout and appearance" page
